familyTheme: Single-skill narration generation across audiobook assembly, operations briefing audio, batch call prompts, and release digest voice delivery.

derivedTasks.title: Similar - Founder Notes Audio Assembly
derivedTasks.goal: Assemble two local founder-note chapters into one narrated MP3 and emit a chapter timing manifest.
derivedTasks.skillBenefitRationale: The task benefits from reliable chunked text-to-speech generation and audio concatenation.

derivedTasks.title: Transfer - Incident Briefing Voice Timeline
derivedTasks.goal: Convert incident updates into one WAV briefing with structured cue timing metadata.
derivedTasks.skillBenefitRationale: The same synthesis workflow is transferred to operational timeline narration output.

derivedTasks.title: Transfer - Reminder Call Batch Audio
derivedTasks.goal: Produce one FLAC batch audio for reminder calls and a summary report by priority tier.
derivedTasks.skillBenefitRationale: The task transfers synthesis into a CSV-driven batch voice production format.

derivedTasks.title: Transfer - Release Digest Narration
derivedTasks.goal: Narrate release notes into AAC audio and emit section-level marker timing CSV.
derivedTasks.skillBenefitRationale: The task transfers long-form synthesis to sectioned technical digest narration.
